timing_contract: independent end-to-end runs from A0; graph generation, compilation and all reference audits excluded; no concurrent timed benchmarks
SLQ_policy: fixed Rademacher matrix seed=20261031+739, p32 prefix of p128, h=15; same probes shared by exhaustive and lazy variants
count_policy: RHS for IBP/Raw means one incidence vector; SLQ probe RHS means one probe for one trace evaluation; these are not interchangeable

workloads.reference_selection_method: q64, tol1e-11 deterministic greedy; dense spectral marginal auditing on Small-BA

sampled_objective_lazy_key_audit.definition: At identical-prefix rounds, compare current exhaustive CRN-SLQ-p128 marginal with the latest point key cached by actual CRN-SLQ-CELF-p128; tolerance1e-10*max(1,abs(current)).

workloads.reference_roundoff_note: Dense floating eigendecomposition has no directed-rounding certificate. audit_eta bounds quadrature only; no interval below machine precision is claimed.
